svg.title: MSCA-Lite scale alignment and modulation
svg.desc: The left panel illustrates average pooling to 20 by 20 and 10 by 10, bilinear alignment to 40 by 40, and pointwise averaging with the identity feature. The right panel computes an energy weight from that mean and multiplies it by the same original F shown in both panels. All patches are computed from a schematic input.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 4. Scientific source: MSCA_Lite.forward, Figure 4 label sheet and equations (1)–(2) in revision 44. Layout reference: LoftUp, ICCV 2025, Fig. 3, for juxtaposing visibly different spatial resolutions. Native SVG drawing. Monochrome composition proof.

g.inkscape:label: Arithmetic mean of the three aligned spatial features
